d.note: Route 3 michigan stand in Morrisonville, one of the five stops on the Town of Plattsburgh's July Michigan Month passport.
Route 9 michigan stand with car-hop service, which the regional tourism listing calls the oldest michigan stand in the North Country. It is on the town's 2026 Michigan Month list.
d.fn: The Adirondack tourism listing says it has been family owned since 1942 and gives 67 Waterhouse St as the address. NYSDOH lists the stand at 4731 State Route 9, and InsideHook (2020) gives 4729 U.S. 9. Its location history isn't stated.

d.note: Family restaurant serving homemade breakfast, lunch and the local michigan; on the 2026 Michigan Month passport.
